title: Pretraining Objectives — Turn Raw Text into Its Own Answer Key
key_insight: Next-token prediction uses earlier tokens as the question and the actual next token as the answer. Every position supplies another training example.
body:
## Turn Raw Text into Its Own Answer Key

A library has trillions of words but no human-written label for each sentence. Manually grading all of it is impossible.

Next-token prediction uses earlier tokens as the question and the actual next token as the answer. Every position supplies another training example.

The model learns patterns useful for prediction, not a guaranteed database of truth. Frequent text and data quality strongly shape what it learns.
common_mistakes: Pretraining guarantees every generated claim is true.
A causal model trains by reading the answer tokens ahead.
Data quality cannot affect a fixed mathematical loss.
mini_exercise: Draw “Turn Raw Text into Its Own Answer Key” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: The objective determines what patterns a foundation model is rewarded for learning before task-specific adaptation.
explain_back_prompt: Using “Turn Raw Text into Its Own Answer Key,” explain Pretraining Objectives without assuming the listener knows modern AI.
